risks.title: Government Policy Dependence
risks.score_rationale: Federal or state policies could be enacted that restrict the availability of and increase the costs associated with fuels or generation technologies such as natural gas or nuclear power that enable Duke Energy to reduce its carbon emissions. (Item 1A) Citation: "Duke Energy is subject to business, policy, regulatory, technology, economic and competitive uncertainties and contingencies". Position: haut Item 1A.

risks.title: Risques réglementaires
risks.score_rationale: Duke Energy is subject to regulation by FERC and state utility regulatory agencies which have jurisdiction over rates and investment recovery. Regulatory decisions can materially impact operating results. (Item 1A, Item 4) Citation: "REGULATORY, LEGISLATIVE AND LEGAL RISKS The Duke Energy Registrants’ regulated utility revenues, earnings and results". Position: haut Item 1A.

risks.title: Concurrence accrue
risks.score_rationale: Increased competition in the energy sector may impact Duke Energy's operating results and market share across its service territories. risks.title: Risques environnementaux et climatiques
risks.score_rationale: Environmental regulations can increase operating costs. Duke Energy must manage coal-fired facility retirements, replacement generation availability, and comply with emission standards. (Item 1A, Item 7) Citation: "The costs to comply with environmental laws and regulations could have a material effect on". Position: milieu Item 1A.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The availability and deployment of generation and grid technologies can impact Duke Energy's ability to achieve modernization and carbon reduction objectives. (Item 1A) Citation: "Duke Energy is subject to business, policy, regulatory, technology, economic and competitive uncertainties and contingencies". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Technologies play a key role in Duke Energy's energy modernization strategy

risks.title: Risque d'exploitation nucléaire
risks.score_rationale: Duke Energy operates multiple nuclear facilities including McGuire, Oconee, Catawba, Robinson, Brunswick and Harris. Nuclear liability is capped by the Price-Anderson Act at approximately 16.3 billion dollars. Uninsured losses could materially impact operations. (Item 5) Citation: "REGULATORY, LEGISLATIVE AND LEGAL RISKS The Duke Energy Registrants’ regulated utility revenues, earnings and results". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Nuclear operations represent significant liability and regulatory exposure

company_description: Duke Energy Corporation, through its subsidiaries, operates as an energy company in the United States. The company operates through two segments: Electric Utilities and Infrastructure (EU&I); and Gas Utilities and Infrastructure (GU&I). The EU&I segment generates, transmits, distributes, and sells electricity to customers in the Southeast and Midwest regions. It generates electricity through coal, hydroelectric, natural gas, oil, renewables, and nuclear fuel. This segment also engages in the wholesale of electricity to municipalities, electric cooperative utilities, and other load-serving entities. The GU&I segment distributes natural gas to customers in the residential, commercial, industrial, and power generation natural gas sectors; and invests in pipeline transmission projects, renewable natural gas projects, and natural gas storage facilities. The company was formerly known as Duke Energy Holding Corp. and changed its name to Duke Energy Corporation in April 2006. Duke Energy Corporation was founded in 1904 and is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.

en.moat: Its primary moat lies in its extensive regulated infrastructure, exclusive operating licenses in many geographic areas, and high switching costs for customers tied to its distribution networks.
en.risks: Duke Energy faces significant regulatory risks concerning electricity tariffs and environmental policies, as well as major investment challenges for grid modernization and the energy transition.

fr.activity: Duke Energy est l'une des plus grandes utilities électriques régulées américaines.
fr.products: Ses activités couvrent production, transmission et distribution d'électricité et gaz naturel.
fr.customers: Ses clients sont environ 8 millions de particuliers et entreprises dans 7 États (Carolines, Floride, Midwest).
fr.edge: Son atout est une base d'actifs régulés étendue et une exposition à des régions à forte croissance démographique (Carolines, Floride).

fr.positioning: Dans le sous-secteur Électricité, Duke est l'une des plus grandes utilities électriques US devant Southern et NextEra.
fr.tech_products: Le groupe exécute un plan d'investissement massif (~145 Mds USD sur 10 ans) en grid hardening, solar et stockage.
fr.moat: Son moat repose sur la régulation tarifaire, la base d'actifs régulés et les rendements autorisés stables.
fr.risks: Les risques incluent l'exécution du capex décarbonation, les ouragans (Carolines, Floride) et la pression réglementaire sur les recouvrements.

enrich_risks._source: Existing risks FR translation + EN preserved (batch 2/4 final FR)

risks.title: Dépendance aux politiques publiques
risks.score_rationale: Des politiques fédérales ou étatiques pourraient restreindre la disponibilité et augmenter les coûts des combustibles ou technologies de production (gaz naturel, nucléaire) qui permettent à Duke Energy de réduire ses émissions de carbone. (Item 1A). Citation: "BUSINESS STRATEGY RISKS Duke Energy s future results could be adversely affected if it is"
risks.summary: Les politiques publiques peuvent peser sur la stratégie énergétique et la structure de coûts de Duke Energy.
risks.summary_en: Government policies can impact Duke Energy's energy strategy and cost structure
risks.score_rationale_en: Federal or state policies could be enacted that restrict the availability of and increase the costs associated with fuels or generation technologies such as natural gas or nuclear power that enable Duke Energy to reduce its carbon emissions. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Risques réglementaires
risks.score_rationale: Duke Energy est soumis à la régulation de la FERC et des agences étatiques qui ont autorité sur les tarifs et le recouvrement des investissements. Les décisions réglementaires peuvent avoir un impact significatif sur les résultats opérationnels. (Item 1A, Item 4). Citation: "BUSINESS STRATEGY RISKS Duke Energy s future results could be adversely affected if it is"
risks.summary: Les régulateurs peuvent limiter la capacité de Duke Energy à récupérer ses coûts via les mécanismes tarifaires.
risks.summary_en: Regulators can limit Duke Energy's ability to recover costs through rate mechanisms
risks.score_rationale_en: Duke Energy is subject to regulation by FERC and state utility regulatory agencies which have jurisdiction over rates and investment recovery. Regulatory decisions can materially impact operating results. (Item 1A, Item 4)

risks.title: Intensification de la concurrence
risks.score_rationale: L'intensification de la concurrence dans le secteur de l'énergie peut affecter les résultats opérationnels et la part de marché de Duke Energy sur ses territoires de service. (Item 1A). Citation: "as North Carolina and South Carolina in Duke Energy Carolinas' and Duke Energy Progress' service"
risks.summary: La concurrence peut réduire la part de marché de Duke Energy dans ses territoires de service clés.
risks.summary_en: Competition can reduce Duke Energy's market share in key regions
risks.score_rationale_en: Increased competition in the energy sector may impact Duke Energy's operating results and market share across its service territories. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Risques environnementaux et climatiques
risks.score_rationale: Les réglementations environnementales peuvent augmenter les coûts opérationnels. Duke Energy doit gérer la fermeture des centrales au charbon, la disponibilité de la production de remplacement et le respect des normes d'émissions. (Item 1A, Item 7). Citation: "BUSINESS STRATEGY RISKS Duke Energy s future results could be adversely affected if it is"
risks.summary: Les réglementations environnementales et le changement climatique peuvent affecter la stratégie énergétique et la valeur des actifs de Duke Energy.
risks.summary_en: Environmental regulations and climate change can impact Duke Energy's energy strategy and asset values
risks.score_rationale_en: Environmental regulations can increase operating costs. Duke Energy must manage coal-fired facility retirements, replacement generation availability, and comply with emission standards. (Item 1A, Item 7)

risks.title: Dépendance technologique
risks.score_rationale: La disponibilité et le déploiement des technologies de production et de réseau peuvent peser sur la capacité de Duke Energy à atteindre ses objectifs de modernisation et de réduction des émissions de carbone. (Item 1A). Citation: "fuels or generation technologies, such as natural gas or nuclear power, that enable Duke Energy"
risks.summary: Les technologies jouent un rôle clé dans la stratégie de modernisation énergétique de Duke Energy.
risks.summary_en: Technologies play a key role in Duke Energy's energy modernization strategy
risks.score_rationale_en: The availability and deployment of generation and grid technologies can impact Duke Energy's ability to achieve modernization and carbon reduction objectives. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Risque lié aux opérations nucléaires
risks.score_rationale: Duke Energy exploite plusieurs centrales nucléaires dont McGuire, Oconee, Catawba, Robinson, Brunswick et Harris. La responsabilité nucléaire est plafonnée par le Price-Anderson Act à environ 16,3 milliards de dollars. Des pertes non assurées pourraient avoir un impact significatif sur les opérations. (Item 5). Citation: "BUSINESS STRATEGY RISKS Duke Energy s future results could be adversely affected if it is"
risks.summary: Les opérations nucléaires représentent une exposition réglementaire et de responsabilité significative.
risks.summary_en: Nuclear operations represent significant liability and regulatory exposure
risks.score_rationale_en: Duke Energy operates multiple nuclear facilities including McGuire, Oconee, Catawba, Robinson, Brunswick and Harris. Nuclear liability is capped by the Price-Anderson Act at approximately 16.3 billion dollars. Uninsured losses could materially impact operations. (Item 5)

risks.title: Exécution de la stratégie
risks.score_rationale: Les résultats futurs de Duke Energy dépendent de la mise en œuvre réussie de sa stratégie : fournir une énergie fiable à bas coût tout en équilibrant modernisation et réduction des émissions, dans un contexte d'incertitudes réglementaires. (Item 1A). Citation: "BUSINESS STRATEGY RISKS Duke Energy s future results could be adversely affected if it is"
risks.summary: L'exécution des objectifs stratégiques est soumise aux incertitudes économiques, politiques et réglementaires.
risks.summary_en: Execution on strategic objectives is subject to business, policy, regulatory and economic uncertainties
risks.score_rationale_en: Duke Energy's future results depend on successfully implementing its business strategy to provide reliable energy while maintaining low costs and balancing modernization with carbon reduction objectives amid regulatory uncertainties. (Item 1A)
